response:

Staying home also protects your fellow parishioners from getting sick. You might consider checking if your parish streams Mass online, or simply spending some quiet time in prayer from your bed when you feel up to it. 

Focus on hydrating and resting today. How are you feeling overall—do you have everything you need to stay comfortable?
